snippet.title: Echoes From Ciudadela | ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER
snippet.description:
Wield your Balearic sling in a first-person puzzle narrative adventure through ancient ruins. Uncover a lost civilization and reactivate forgotten machines to reveal the secrets buried beneath Ciudadela.

Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4019790/Echoes_From_Ciudadela/
